title: What is SG Batch Payments?
content: SG Batch Payments is a product for submitting multiple Singapore business payments in one batch. SG 批量付款允许企业一次提交多笔新加坡付款。This public overview does not confirm any release version, incident root cause, recovery status, or customer communication approval.

title: PAY-231: Batch Payments v2.3 release approval
content: The release candidate passed UAT. Engineering and Compliance approved SG Batch Payments v2.3 for production deployment on 20 September 2026. 上线审批已完成。The production release must use change ticket CHG-8821.

title: Production deployment: payments-v2.3.0
content: Authoritative deployment record: payments-v2.3.0 was deployed to Singapore production at 10:00 SGT on 20 September 2026 under CHG-8821. 正式发布记录确认 v2.3 已上线。

title: #payments-release announcement
content: Release announcement: SG Batch Payments v2.3 is live in production. Operations should monitor payout failure rate and use the approved customer communication workflow for incidents. v2.3 已上线。

title: INC-442: Duplicate retry key caused batch payout failures
content: Technical root cause: the v2.3 retry worker reused an idempotency key after a partial timeout. The receiving payment rail rejected the retried items as duplicates, causing 7.4% of affected batch items to fail. No customer funds were lost. 技术根因是重试任务复用了幂等键。

title: #payments-engineering incident discussion
content: The team reproduced the failure when the retry worker received a partial timeout. Do not share stack traces or idempotency implementation details outside Engineering. 工程群确认故障与 partial timeout 和 idempotency key 有关。

title: Batch Payments incident runbook
content: For a batch payout incident, Operations must pause new affected batches, check the release registry, confirm recovery metrics with Engineering, and use the approved customer template. Operations must not disclose internal implementation details. 运营事故处理流程。

title: Production hotfix: payments-v2.3.1
content: Authoritative recovery record: payments-v2.3.1 was deployed at 04:30 SGT on 21 September 2026. Monitoring from 04:35 to 05:05 showed the payout failure rate returned to the normal baseline. 服务恢复监控正常。

title: #payments-ops recovery confirmation
content: Operations update at 05:10 SGT: service metrics are back to baseline after v2.3.1. Customer communication still requires the incident lead and Compliance to approve the final wording. 服务已恢复，但客户沟通仍需审批。

title: Customer incident communication policy
content: A customer-facing recovery statement may be sent only after Operations confirms stable service metrics and Compliance approves the wording. Do not include stack traces, provider secrets, customer identifiers, or unverified root-cause claims. 客户沟通必须经过运营确认和合规审批。

title: Approved customer statement for INC-442
content: Compliance approval at 05:40 SGT: Operations may tell affected customers that SG Batch Payments experienced elevated failures, no customer funds were lost, a fix was deployed, and service metrics returned to normal. The technical root cause must not be included. 客户恢复通知已获批。

title: INC-442 engineering postmortem
content: The postmortem confirms the idempotency-key reuse defect as the root cause. Corrective actions: bind every retry to the original payment item identifier, add partial-timeout tests, and alert on duplicate rejection spikes. 事故复盘包含敏感工程细节。

title: Old #product message: v2.3 is probably not live
content: At 09:20 SGT on 20 September, before the production deployment, a product team member wrote: 'I think v2.3 is probably not live yet.' This message predates the authoritative 10:00 deployment event and is stale for current release status. 这是一条上线前的旧消息。
